newsitem.title: FRANCE: Globe Air is GSA for Arrow Air in continental Euro.
newsitem.headline: Globe Air is GSA for Arrow Air in continental Euro.

text.p: Globe Air Cargo said it has been appointed continental Europe cargo sales agent for Miami-based freighter airline, Arrow Air, effective June 16.
"This is a first-time appointment and we will be responsible for Arrow Air's European sales with the exception of UK and Ireland," Globe Air Cargo president, Guy Tordjman, told Reuters.
Globe Air currently had an on-forwarding service to Miami via a ten-tonne block booking on a weekly Boeing 747-400F charter operated by Cargolux from Luxembourg, Tordjman said.
"It's likely we'll seek to increase our space allocation on this flight following our sales agreement with Arrow Air and will explore other air transport solutions to Miami from Europe."
Arrow Air operates a fleet of Douglas DC8s and Lockheed Tristar 1011s on routes from Miami to Central and South America includng Panama, Lima, Quito, Asuncion, Tordjman added.

Globe Air is already represents other Latin America airlines, including Panamian carrier, COPA and Avianca from Colombia with whom it signed an agreement in December 1996. The latter operates three weekly Boeing 767 passenger flights between Paris and Bogota.
When the Avianca agreement was announced, Tordjman said his company had developed a special expertise in the Latin America market and was setting up a hub and spoke network based on Bogota."
Globe Air's other customers include Air China, Air Malta, Avianca, Biman Bangla Desh, COPA, Ethiopian Airlines, Royal Nepal Airlines, US Air and Vietnam Airlines.
